name: Ludi
install:
set -euo pipefail
node -e "const v = process.versions.node; const [maj] = v.split('.').map(Number); const ok = maj >= 22; if (!ok) { console.error('Unsupported Node.js ' + v + '. Need >=22.'); process.exit(1); } console.log('Node ' + v + ' OK');}"
corepack enable
corepack prepare pnpm@9.15.5 --activate
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm --filter @ludi/cli exec playwright install --with-deps chromium
